written: 2026-11-23 evening, before any reconstruction number was computed. Known already: normalizer ranges (action y scale x0.735, tactile dims 0 and 2 x0.71 / x0.57 under N1).
question: The LDP training code hands its own normalizer to the fixed AT. With the 45 demonstrations + 27 LEAVE segments (ldp_tk, ldp_tkL) the AT therefore runs with statistics N1 it was not trained with. Does the fixed AT (at_20261120) still reconstruct the action chunks - of the demonstrations and of the LEAVE segments - under N1, and would the AT's own statistics N0 be better or worse?

arms.N0_at: action + tactile statistics of the 45 demonstrations
arms.actN1_tacN0 / actN0_tacN1: descriptive split of the two changes

data: low-dimensional arrays only (action 6, contact_8d 8), copied read-only from the 5090: tkL zarr (45 + 27) and tk_ds segments (held LEAVE 6, ALIGN train + held). Chunks sampled by the AT's own dataset class and config (horizon 32).
measure: mean absolute error between raw command and AT encode -> decode (with tactile temporal condition), in raw command units; all 6 dims (err_all) and y (err_y). Reference REF = demo45 under N0 (the AT's in-distribution level).

criteria.demo_keep: N1 keeps the demonstrations if err_all(demo45, N1) <= 1.25 x REF_all and err_y(demo45, N1) <= 1.25 x REF_y
criteria.leave_ok: an arm is OK on LEAVE if, on leave_train27 AND leave_held6, err_all <= 1.5 x REF_all and err_y <= 1.5 x REF_y; BAD if either exceeds 2.5 x; between = MARGINAL
criteria.decision: N1 demo_keep and leave OK -> keep the running training as it is. N1 not OK and N0 OK -> recommend restart with at_normalizer_path (N0). Both BAD -> recommend retraining the AT on demonstrations + LEAVE. MARGINAL cases are reported with numbers and no recommendation is forced.

limits_written_in_advance: Reconstruction with the true chunk as encoder input is an upper bound: at run time the latent comes from the LDP.
The LEAVE training segments are not AT training data in either arm, so 'train' and 'held' LEAVE are both unseen for the AT.
Tactile effect on the decoder is small in earlier measurements; the split arms are descriptive only.
One AT, one seed for the posterior sample (kl weight 1e-6, sample noise small).
